name: Lens imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, holding out in front of it, like a lantern, a jagged shard of glowing red lens glass that shines a thin red beam, squinting one eye

poses.stand: hovering on spread bat wings, holding the red glass shard out in front of it in both claws
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hovers, squinting through the red glass shard and turning it this way and that

attack.action: raises the red lens shard and it flares blinding red, a thick red beam blasting out of it to the right, then it lowers the shard, blinking

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
